example: import { Image, ImagePreviewGroup, Prose } from "@godxjp/ui/data-display";
name: Image

props.description: Required (as on Thumbnail). Also names the trigger "Preview: {alt}". Pass "" for a decorative picture.
props.name: alt

props.description: antd shape. `false` = a plain, non-clickable picture that also leaves its group. `src` shows a different (larger) file in the preview. Defaults: scaleStep 0.5, minScale 1, maxScale 50.
props.name: preview
props.type: boolean | { visible?, onVisibleChange?(visible, prevVisible), src?, mask?, scaleStep?, minScale?, maxScale? }

props.description: Shown when `src` fails. A failed picture does not open a preview (antd).
props.name: fallback

props.description: Painted over the frame until the picture loads; `true` = a muted block.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: antd Image: size the FRAME (number = px, or a CSS length); the picture fills it. `width` alone keeps the picture's ratio; a fixed height crops per `fit`. Also set on the img.
props.name: width / height

props.description: Thumbnail frame on the Thumbnail height scale (64 / 96 / 160px) at `--thumbnail-width-ratio` (4 / 3), cropped to fill. godx extension; `width`/`height` override the side they name.
props.name: size

props.description: object-fit inside a fixed frame. Default `cover` once the height is fixed (size or height).
props.name: fit

props.description: Text under the picture in a figure held to the picture's width — a long file name truncates instead of widening the tile. godx extension.
props.name: caption

props.description: Explicit gallery instead of the Images rendered under the group. A clicked child opens at the item with its own src.
props.name: ImagePreviewGroup.items

props.description: antd shape and argument order. `false` turns every Image under the group into a plain picture.
props.name: ImagePreviewGroup.preview
props.type: boolean | { current?, onChange?(current, prevCurrent), visible?, onVisibleChange?(visible, prevVisible), scaleStep?, minScale?, maxScale? }

props.description: Shown in the preview for a picture that fails to load.
props.name: ImagePreviewGroup.fallback

related: Thumbnail — a framed picture at a fixed height, with no preview.
Prose — the Markdown body the group usually wraps.
Carousel — slides on the page itself, not a full-viewport preview.
tagline: antd `Image` + `Image.PreviewGroup`: a picture that opens in a full-viewport preview (zoom in/out by button, wheel or double-click; rotate; flip; reset; drag to pan). Inside an `ImagePreviewGroup` every Image at any depth joins one gallery in document order — prev/next buttons, ←/→, a "2 / 3" counter. Esc closes; focus is trapped and returned to the picture.
usage: DO wrap a rendered Markdown body in ImagePreviewGroup and map its `img` to `<Image>` — every screenshot of the article then pages in one preview, in reading order.
DO pass `preview={false}` for a logo or icon inside that body so it neither opens nor counts.
DO use `Image.PreviewGroup` or `ImagePreviewGroup` — the same component.
DON'T hand-roll a lightbox from Dialog + Carousel: it has no zoom, no arrow keys and a 32rem box. That composition is what this replaces.
DON'T nest an Image inside a link or button: the thumbnail is itself a button.
DO size an attachment gallery with `size="md"` (96px, 4:3, cropped) and put the file name in `caption` — never an inline style reading `--thumbnail-block-size`.
useCases: Screenshots in a test result or wiki page that the reader opens large and pages through.
A product or evidence gallery with zoom and rotate.
